explore-double.title: Double the power
explore-double.prompt: Set the amplifier's gain so 100 W becomes 200 W.
hints: Try a few dB at a time.
explore-double.success: +3 dB doubles the power: 100 W → 200 W.

explore-loss.title: Lose it in the feedline
explore-loss.prompt: Set the feedline loss so only 25 W of your 100 W reaches the antenna.
explore-loss.success: −6 dB: half, then half again. 100 W → 25 W.

explore-smeter.title: Back to S9
explore-smeter.prompt: Cut your power until the report falls from S9 + 10 dB to S9.
explore-smeter.success: 20 W gives S9: a tenth of the power is −10 dB.
